tasks.short: Page individuals wanted at the box office

steps.what: Confirm the requested individual and approve a concise paging message
Page individuals wanted at the box office over the public-address system

tasks.design: Configure fixed paging templates and speech playback in {OTHER}, the public-address system. The attendant confirms the name, location and timing, approves the exact message and retains manual announcements when the system cannot pronounce it clearly.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff must leave other work to reach a microphone and repeat short routine pages.
tasks.enabler_now: Template-based announcement playback is a deterministic alternative where the installed system supports it.
tasks.still_hard: A name can be mispronounced, and some situations should not be announced publicly.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether a public page is appropriate and protect sensitive details.
tasks.altitude: Fewer microphone trips for routine pages; authority to approve public messages remains with staff.

reach.learn: Privacy, quiet periods and urgent announcement precedence

evidence.claim: Fixed templates and speech playback can support short routine pages; public-address compatibility and labour saving are unverified E1 assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is confirming a received box office request and making its page. Creating the original request and the individual's response remain outside this task and unchanged.

The venue attendant in s1 captures display name, pronunciation when needed, return location, announcement zone and permitted time. The entire 40 hours remains for request clarification, field entry, playback preview and exact-message approval; this is not free structured input.

s2 consumes only the approved message snapshot. A failed preview, unavailable zone or urgent situation uses a manual microphone; these exceptions consume part of the additional five-hour focal allowance, with savings reduced if more common.
Test native announcement templates and playback first. Existing automated pages earn no new labour saving; do not add custom integration if manual paging is already quicker.
unknowns: Baseline microphone travel and announcement time
Frequency of sensitive or urgent pages
research_questions: Does a trial remove microphone time after accounting for entry, preview and manual pronunciation exceptions?

already_counted.description: Request clarification, field capture, preview and approval

incremental.description: Playback faults, manual fallback and template checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact spoken message, pronunciation preview, zone and scheduled time approved in s1; any change invalidates approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100, R=40; gross 60%, less five focal upkeep and fallback hours gives central net 55%. The conservative high allows another 20 hours for manual pages; low assumes only ten hours of microphone work removed before the five-hour allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Confirm the replacement advertising displays and coordinate safe access
Remove old displays and install replacements with colleagues

tasks.design: Keep coordinated physical display changes with venue staff. Approved materials may be referenced in {DOCS}; no digital-signage replacement or new production process is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Displays need physical handling and safe access around patrons.
tasks.enabler_now: No technical change is needed for this physical task.
tasks.still_hard: Large materials and awkward positions require colleagues to work together.
tasks.human_edge: Handle materials safely and notice mounting or access problems.
tasks.altitude: The attendant's physical duties and decision rights are unchanged.

reach.task: Arrange safe access to display locations

evidence.claim: Coordinated physical display replacement retains its labour; converting the venue to digital signage is outside this design.

assumptions: Boundary includes this attendant's coordination and handling time; colleagues' handling time remains outside the focal denominator and is unchanged.
The marketing team provides already approved physical materials through its existing production process. No automated step relies on a new structured input.
No new software or process is introduced. Existing native document access is sufficient and ongoing incremental upkeep is zero.
research_questions: Which display changes require facilities assistance?

incremental.description: No new system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, zero gross and net saving; physical handling and colleague coordination are retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Offer and distribute programs to patrons

tasks.design: Keep the physical offer and handover of programs with the attendant. Information may also exist in {CMS}, but no patron self-service requirement or replacement of printed programs is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The requested service is a physical handover to an arriving patron.
tasks.enabler_now: No technical change removes that handover within the chosen service.
tasks.still_hard: Some patrons need an explanation or help accessing a program.
tasks.human_edge: Notice who needs assistance and offer the program appropriately.

reach.learn: Accessible formats and patron assistance needs

evidence.claim: Physical program distribution does not gain labour savings from a software change in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is offering and handing out the supplied programs, excluding printing, editorial production and replenishment procurement.
No machine step or new structured-input contract is introduced, and no new patron work is required.
No new deployment or configuration is proposed; existing native information access remains sufficient, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Patron needs and accessible program formats
research_questions: Are program formats suitable for patrons who need assistance?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross saving and zero upkeep. Offering and handing out printed programs remains human work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Routine approved pages may take less microphone time; physical displays and program handovers remain staffed.
reach: Work with the box office supervisor on appropriate public announcements
role.ambitious_version: An attendant who can stay near patrons while approved routine pages are played.

job.title: Ushers, Lobby Attendants, and Ticket Takers
